evidence.limits: Transcript (machine, Whisper) arrived after the frames were first coded and was merged in; it mishears a few words near 51 s. Sound effects and music not determinable. Exact money per person only partly visible. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Street stunt in Azrieli Mall: Matan offers cash to followers; each person who does not follow means the amount doubles for the next person (200, 400, 800, 1600), until a man in a Levi's shirt follows and wins 1,600 NIS.
audience: Young Israeli mall-goers and Instagram users (teens, soldiers, young men), and his followers; people who like giveaway content.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption matches the video: it promises 1,600 NIS to one follower and asks to share to story and follow. The video itself shows a chain of cash handouts in a mall, so the caption's 'one of you' framing is a separate story giveaway not shown in the street scenes (a viewer's story screenshot with 1600 appears at the end).

opening.first_frame: Matan full length on an outdoor walkway at Azrieli Center, black shirt, lavalier mic at his chin, a stack of 200 NIS notes in his hand; first caption word 'אז' in the middle of the frame.
opening.s0_1: Starts with the wide shot, cut at about 0.57 s to a tight crop of the cash stack at his belt; word-by-word captions 'אז', 'בלי', 'מגבלה'.
opening.s1_3: Cut at 1.5 s to a medium close-up of him walking toward camera along the bridge; captions 'והגעתי לקניון עזריאלי לחלק כסף' (about 1.5 to 3.0 s), Azrieli sign visible at 2.25 s.
opening.s3_5: He keeps walking and points at the cash with a sideways glance, captions 'לעוקבים שלי', 'בוא נראה', 'נפגוש' (3.25 to 4.75 s); at 5 s cut into the mall to the first girl.
opening.visual_hook: Cash in hand plus a famous landmark location, then straight to an interaction.
opening.spoken_hook: machine transcript 0-3 s: 'אז אני בלי מגבלה של כסף והגעתי לקניון אזריאלי לחלק כסף לעוקבים שלי' (the transcript says אזריאלי; the on-screen caption spells it עזריאלי)
opening.text_hook: אז בלי מגבלה כסף / והגעתי לקניון עזריאלי / לחלק כסף לעוקבים שלי
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 1.5 to 3 (handing out cash to followers)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: no: starts with 'אז בלי מגבלה כסף' which reads as a mid-thought fragment, though the next words make the premise clear within about 3 s
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: yes (cash stack visible and the word 'כסף'; no amount stated)
opening.works_without_sound: yes: word-by-word captions and the visible cash carry the premise

visual.subject_placement: Matan centred or on the right with the interviewee on the left, handheld camera that follows him; high smartphone POV for the phone-screen checks.
visual.setting: Azrieli Center Tel Aviv: outdoor bridge, shopfronts (Fox), a cafe, a food court and a jewellery corridor.
visual.lighting: Natural golden-hour light outside, bright mall lighting inside; unlit handheld look.
visual.color_contrast: Black shirt against light mall surfaces; saturated green and yellow caption accents and blue 200 NIS notes pop.
visual.props_and_gestures: Stack of 200 NIS notes, lavalier mic held to the mouth, pointing, counting notes into hands, people showing their phones with his profile.
visual.supporting_footage: Phone-screen close-ups of his Instagram profile (about 7 s, 30 s, 48 to 50 s, 1:05), a YouTube channel inset (1:06), a viewer's Instagram story with 1600 NIS (1:08 to 1:09), a note graphic and 'X2' graphics.
visual.persistent_branding: none seen (his handle appears only inside shown phone screens)
visual.faces_blurred: no (participants and bystanders are visible, including a soldier)
visual.visual_progression: 0-5 s intro on the bridge; 5-12 s first encounter with two girls on a bench ('את מקבלת' / 'לא' then 'נכפיל' with a red X); 12-21 s shop counter encounter, 400 shown at 15 s; 21-35 s food court soldier, x2, 1600 shown at 34 s; 36-47 s second soldier and two young men, x2; 47-53 s phone check on follower status with confetti at 50 s; 54-59 s handover of cash to a man in a Levi's shirt; 1:00-1:07 closing to camera with CTA; 1:08-1:09 viewer story screenshots; last second black.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: cover shows two girls on a bench in the mall with the title text 'מתן מחלק כסף לעוקבים', same scene as 5-12 s.
visual.ui_interference: Captions sit in the vertical middle (inside the safe zone). The profile inset at 1:05 and the YouTube inset at 1:06 run low in the frame (bottom 35%). Small Instagram handle in the phone screens near the top at about 50 s.

editing.edit_function: Information and stimulation: cuts compress each encounter to its beat (ask, show phone, receive cash), money graphics show amounts ('400' at 15 s, 1600 at 34 s), 'X2' marks the doubling, a red X marks refusals, confetti at 50 s marks a successful follow.
pacing_changes: t=0.57-1.5s: crop to the cash then back out
t=6-13s: a cut about every second
t=29-35s: one longer shot (about 6 s) at the table
t=59.9-66s: slower, one 6 s talking shot closing to camera
t=1:08-1:10: two story screenshots, then black
editing.ending: Matan walking in the mall: machine transcript says to keep following, 'גם באינסטגרם, גם ביוטיוב, גם בטיק טוק', 'זה שווה לכם הרבה מאוד כסף'; captions 'לעקוב נתראה בקניון לכם אז באינסטגרם ביוטיוב שווה'; profile and YouTube insets; the winner's story with 1600 and a black last second.
editing.loop: no: ends on a black frame after story screenshots; the opening does not follow from it.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: low rewatch value; the draw is watching strangers react to cash and the doubling pattern.

sound.delivery: Loudness stays steady at about -15 to -20 dB, which suggests continuous talk; short dips to about -30 dB near 10 to 11 s and 35 to 36 s and a near silence of -40 dB at about 37.5 s. Energetic, conversational, interview style.
sound.music: unclear (dossier shows original audio only; no steady music evidence)
sound.sync: Word-by-word captions match the machine transcript and are timed to speech; green amount graphics appear as each prize is stated (15 s, 26 s, 34 s, 37 s).

text.colour_coding: White for Matan; yellow for the other person's words ('עוקבת', 'בטיקטוק?', 'אני ממהר'); green for money words and amounts ('שקלים', '400', 'X2', 'ב-1600 חברים'); red X over refusals ('נכפיל', 'עוקבת').
text.placement: Centre of the frame, one to two words at a time.
text.style: Bold white sans with a soft glow, no box; emphasis words in neon green or yellow.
text.density_and_read_time: One word per beat, very fast, easy to read; roughly 2 to 3 words per second.
text.language: Short, colloquial Hebrew, direct address ('אתה עוקב?'-style questions, 'נכפיל', 'אני מכפיל'); money-focused vocabulary.
text.caption_structure: Hook line with 1,600 NIS and a money emoji, then two numbered steps (share to story, follow), a repeat of the follow call and a sign-off line 'נתראה בקניון הבא'; no hashtags in the sample; caption was edited.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew words render correctly; amounts like 1600 and the shekel sign appear mixed with Hebrew and one story overlay shows the sign before the number ('₪1600') which is the story's own text.

story.setup: Matan arrives at Azrieli with cash and states the rule: follow me and get the amount, if not the amount doubles and goes to the next person (machine transcript, about 6 to 10 s).
story.stakes: The prize doubles after each refusal: 200 at 6 s, 400 at 14 s, 800 at 23 s, 1600 at 33 s (machine transcript and money graphics).
story.progression: Two girls on a bench (not followers, 'נכפיל'), a shop assistant (400, not a follower), a soldier at the food court (800, checks his phone, not a follower), a soldier and group of young men at 1600 ('מי עוקב אחריי?'), phone checks with a blocked account joke ('אה, אתה חסום?').
story.payoff: A man in a Levi's shirt follows and wins 1,600 NIS ('יש לנו זוכה ב-1600 שקלים חברים' per machine transcript, about 54 to 59 s); a winner's story at 1:08 shows the cash.
story.resolution: Matan to camera: keep following, he will give away a lot more money in the mall; follow on Instagram, YouTube and TikTok (machine transcript).
story.payoff_delivered: yes: cash is handed over and the recipient's story screenshot shows 1600
friction_points: t=29-33s: phone-check close-ups with little speech (interpretation)
t=48-53s: long wait while a follower status is checked (interpretation)
t=1:00-1:07s: the CTA repeats the opening premise (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 42 comments is not representative. Many ask him to visit their town ('תבוא לירושלים', 'תבוא לרחובות'), some joke about a blocked account ('אה אתה חסום?'), a few mention entering or sharing ('נרשמתי להגרלה', 'שתפתי'), and one doubts that anyone would be his follower ('80000 עוקבים...').
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: One reply under a comment, off topic ('עונה 6 בדיוק עלתה לאוור'), so no giveaway or keyword reply pattern seen.

conversion.cta_timing: about 1:00-1:07 in the video (follow on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok); rule stated at 6 s; caption lists share and follow
conversion.offer: Cash for followers: each refusal doubles the prize (200 to 1,600 NIS); the video's winner got 1,600 NIS; caption: a separate 1,600 NIS to one viewer who shares to story and follows.
conversion.proof: Cash handed over on camera and a recipient's story screenshot.
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: Follow his profile (inset shows his profile with a bio link); no keyword DM funnel.
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: the whole video is built around following him to get money
conversion.destination: Instagram profile and a YouTube channel inset; the bio link text is too small to read.

rights_and_privacy: No third-party film or viral footage. Many identifiable bystanders, including a soldier in uniform and young people, appear unblurred; a follower's Instagram story with their handle is shown. LumeBook would need consent and release forms before copying this format with recognisable faces.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: the premise (cash, a famous mall, followers) is clear within about 3 s; the 'if not, it doubles' rule gives a built-in escalation (200, 400, 800, 1600) and a reason to keep watching until someone wins; fast word-by-word captions and short encounters keep new information arriving every few seconds, and the follow ask is the price of entry.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the early mid-thought opening and the long tail of repeated encounters could cost viewers who do not care about strangers' reactions.

standout_moments.what: Crop to the cash right after the first frame: puts the money in view before the premise is spoken (interpretation).
Money graphic '400' with a note image and green 'X2' on the rule 'if not, I double and pass it on': makes the escalation rule visible.
Confetti over a phone showing his profile: rewards the follow with a visual celebration.
A recipient's own story with 1600: third-party proof that the money was paid.
